comment: Maps every third-party library or adapted code base that can end up in a shipped DVE binary to its license and license text. Read by tools/generate_third_party_notices.py; the dve_third_party_notices_check test fails when a bundled shared library, a linked third-party target or archive, or a matched entry's license text is not covered. 'copyleft': none | weak (LGPL-style: shipping the binary needs the library's corresponding source or a written offer, and users must be able to replace it) | strong (source-availability terms that reach the software using it). 'review' marks something a human must decide before external distribution. 'forbidden' lists shared libraries that must never be bundled (the check and --verify-dir fail on them). License texts are never written here: they come from the installed Debian package's copyright file, the fetched/vendored source tree, or the SDK.

forbidden.reason: libmpg123 (LGPL-2.1) is only pulled in by a libsndfile built with MPEG support; DVE needs no MP3 at run time. Build with DVE_FETCH_SNDFILE=ON (the default), which uses libsndfile without MPEG.

libmp3lame (LGPL-2+, with a GPL-1+-marked fft.c in Debian's copyright file) is only pulled in by a libsndfile built with MPEG support; DVE never encodes MP3. Build with DVE_FETCH_SNDFILE=ON (the default).

entries.name: SDL 3 (Simple DirectMedia Layer)
entries.license: Zlib (Debian's copyright file also lists permissive sub-licenses: Expat, BSD-3-Clause, BSL-1.0, Unicode-3.0, public domain)
entries.notes: A DVE_FETCH_SDL3 build links SDL statically; its LICENSE.txt is used then. SDL's source tree contains a few files under other permissive licenses (hidapi, libm/SunPro, stb_image); Debian's copyright file lists them, the upstream LICENSE.txt does not.

entries.name: RtMidi
entries.license: MIT-style RtMidi license (its request to send modifications upstream is explicitly non-binding)

entries.name: JACK Audio Connection Kit client library (libjack, JACK1 0.126 on Debian 13)
entries.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (libjack; the JACK server and tools are GPL-2.0-or-later and are not shipped)
entries.review: LGPL: shipping libjack.so needs its corresponding source (or a written offer) next to the package. libjack must also match the JACK server on the user's machine, so bundling it is technically fragile. It is pulled in only through RtMidi (editor); set DVE_INSTALL_BUNDLE_JACK=OFF (the default) to leave it to the system.

entries.name: Berkeley DB 5.3 (libdb, needed by JACK1's libjack)
entries.review: Sleepycat clause 3: redistribution in any form must come with information on how to obtain the complete source code of the DB software AND of any accompanying software that uses it (for an executable, all of its modules). Bundling libdb with the editor could therefore oblige you to publish the editor's source. Do not ship it: it is only reachable through libjack, which is not bundled by default (DVE_INSTALL_BUNDLE_JACK=OFF).

entries.name: libsndfile
entries.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (built-in codec sources: ALAC Apache-2.0, GSM 6.10 permissive (TU Berlin), G.72x public domain (Sun))
entries.notes: By default (DVE_FETCH_SNDFILE=ON) DVE builds libsndfile 1.2.2 itself, with Debian's 1.2.2-2+deb13u1 security patches (third_party/libsndfile/patches), as a shared library WITHOUT MPEG support, so libmpg123 and libmp3lame are neither linked nor shipped. It links the system FLAC, Ogg, Vorbis and Opus libraries, which are listed separately. Without that build DVE links the distribution's libsndfile and does not bundle it.
entries.review: LGPL: shipping libsndfile.so needs its corresponding source (or a written offer): the pinned tarball, the patches and the build options named under 'Corresponding source'. Users must be able to replace it; it is a separate .so in lib/dve, which satisfies that.

entries.name: libFLAC
entries.license: BSD-3-Clause (libFLAC; the flac/metaflac tools are GPL and are not shipped)

entries.name: libjpeg-turbo
entries.notes: The IJG license requires the documentation to state that the software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group; this file does that.

entries.name: manifold (vendored v3.5.1)
entries.notes: Upstream ships no NOTICE file, so Apache-2.0 section 4(d) adds nothing beyond the license text.

entries.name: Box3D
entries.license: as stated in the fetched LICENSE file (not built or verified on the packaging box)
entries.review: Not built in the verified presets; confirm the license of the pinned commit before shipping a Box3D build.

entries.name: Steam Audio (phonon)
entries.review: Not available on the packaging box; the SDK archive may carry additional third-party notices (check its root) that must be added before shipping.

entries.name: Slug font rendering (reference algorithm and shaders)
entries.license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (credit required when distributed)
